en: Black holes are one of the strangest things in existence.
zh: 黑洞是一種奇怪的存在

en: They don't seem to make any sense at all.
zh: 它們看似不合乎常理

en: Where do they come from...
zh: 它們從何而來？

notes.example: How come you didn't text me back?

en: ...and what happens if you fall into one?
zh: 而如果你掉入黑洞又會發生什麼事？

en: Stars are incredibly massive collections of mostly hydrogen atoms that collapsed from enormous gas cloud under their own gravity.
zh: 恆星大得驚人，其成份主要是氫原子由龐大的氣體雲因自身的引力而塌陷所形成

notes.example: The star collapsed inward once its fuel ran dry.

en: In their core, nuclear fusion crushes hydrogen atoms into helium releasing a tremendous amount of energy
zh: 在它們的核心，核聚變將氫原子合成氦原子，釋放出極大量的能量在它們的核心，核聚變將氫原子合成氦原子，釋放出極大量的能量

en: This energy, in the form of radiation, pushes against gravity, maintaining a delicate balance between the two forces.
zh: 這些能量以輻射形式，向外抵抗著引力這些能量以輻射形式，向外抵抗著引力在兩股力（引力和輻射壓力）之間，維持著微妙的平衡

en: As long as there is fusion in the core, a star remains stable enough.
zh: 只要核心有核聚變發生恆星便能維持穩定

en: But for stars with way more mass then our own sun the heat and pressure at the core allow them to fuse heavier elements
zh: 但是，對於質量遠比太陽大的恆星在高溫及高壓的環境下，它們的核心可以以核聚變形成較重的元素

en: until they reach iron.
zh: 直至形成鐵

en: Unlike all the elements that went before, the fusion process that creates iron doesn't generate any energy.
zh: 與鐵之前的元素不同核聚變形成鐵的過程，並不產生能量核聚變形成鐵的過程，並不產生能量

en: Iron builds up at the center of the star until it reaches a critical amount
zh: 鐵在恆星的中心累積直至它到達臨界點

en: and the balance between radiation and gravity is suddenly broken.
zh: 輻射壓力與引力突然失衡

en: The core collapses.
zh: 核心便向內塌陷

en: Within a fraction of a second, the star implodes.
zh: 在極短時間內，恆星發生內爆 （一般爆炸是向外；而內爆則是向內塌陷） 在極短時間內，恆星發生內爆 （一般爆炸是向外；而內爆則是向內塌陷）

notes.zh: just need a second：請稍等我們一下
notes.example: Sorry, we just need a second to check the menu.

en: Moving at about the quarter of the speed of light, feeding even more mass into the core.
zh: 以光速的四分之一倍內陷提供更多質量給予核心

en: It's at this very moment that all the heavier elements in the universe are created, as the star dies, in a super nova explosion.
zh: 宇宙中所有較重的元素就在這非常時刻形成接著的超新星爆炸標誌著恆星的死亡

en: This produces either a neutron star, or if the star is massive enough, the entire mass of the core collapses into a black hole.
zh: 這可能會形成中子星或者，如果恆星質量夠大整個恆星的質量便塌陷成一個黑洞

en: If you looked at a black hole, what you'd really be seeing is the event horizon.
zh: 如果你望向一個黑洞你所看到的只是它的「事件穹界」（又稱「事界」）

en: Anything that crosses the event horizon needs to be travelling faster than the speed of light to escape.
zh: 任何東西越過事界需要以超光速的速度才能逃脫

en: In other words, its impossible.
zh: 換言之，這是不可能

en: So we just see a black sphere reflecting nothing.
zh: 所以我們只能看見一個不反射任何東西的黑色球面所以我們只能看見一個不反射任何東西的黑色球面

en: But if the event horizon is the black part, what is the "hole" part of the black hole?
zh: 如果事界是黑洞「黑」的部分那黑洞「洞」的部分呢？

en: The singularity.
zh: 「奇點」

en: We're not sure what it is exactly.
zh: 我們不肯定它是什麼

en: A singularity may be indefinitely dense, meaning all its mass is concentrated into a single point in space,
zh: 奇點的密度可能無限大即是黑洞所有質量都集中在空間中的一點

en: with no surface or volume, or something completely different.
zh: 它沒有面積，沒有體積或者是與我們所想的完全不同

en: Right now, we just don't know.
zh: 現在，我們仍不知道

en: its like a "dividing by zero"error.
zh: 這就好像「除以零」的錯誤 （「除以零」即分母為零的分數，其結果沒有定義，計算機會顯示為錯誤）

en: By the way, black holes do not suck things up like a vacuum cleaner, If we were to swap the sun for an equally massive black hole,
zh: 順帶一提，黑洞不會像吸塵機般吸走附近的東西如果把太陽換成同等質量的黑洞

en: nothing much would change for earth, except that we would freeze to death, of course.
zh: 對地球沒有什麼影響當然，我們將會凍死

en: what would happen to you if you fell into a black hole?
zh: 當你跌入黑洞時會發生什麼事呢？

en: The experience of time is different around black holes, from the outside, you seem to slow down as you approach the event horizon,
zh: 黑洞附近的時間會有所不同從外面看當你接近事界，你看似慢下來

en: so time passes slower for you.
zh: 你所感受到的時間會較慢

en: at some point, you would appear to freeze in time, slowly turn red, and disapear.
zh: 到達某一點時，你就好像靜止不動，你的時間停下來 （對於外面的觀察者） 你的顏色會漸漸變紅，最终消失 （引力紅移現象） 你的顏色會漸漸變紅，最终消失 （引力紅移現象）

en: While from your perspective, you can watch the rest of the universe in fast forward, kind of like seeing into the future.
zh: 而在你的角度你會看到整個宇宙在快速向前演化類似看見未來一樣

notes.zh: 向前（move forward：走出低谷繼續前進）
notes.example: Mistakes are just feedback to help us move forward.

en: Right now, we don't know what happens next, but we think it could be one of two things: One, you die a quick death.
zh: 現在，我們不知道接下來會發生什麼事但我們認為，將會是以下兩種結果的其中一種一：你會死得很快

en: A black hole curves space so much, that once you cross the event horizon, there is only one possible direction.
zh: 黑洞大幅扭曲時空一旦你越過事界只剩下唯一一個方向

en: you can take this - literally - inside the event horizon, you can only go in one direction.
zh: 你可以想像成，在事界內你只可以向一個方向走

en: Its like being in a really tight alley that closes behind you after each step.
zh: 就好像你在一條小巷，每走一步，後方的路都會不斷封鎖

en: The mass of a black hole is so concentrated, at some point even tiny distances of a few centimeters,
zh: 黑洞的質量非常集中即使是很短的距離

en: would means that gravity acts with millions of times more force on different parts of your body.
zh: 你身體不同部分會感受到百萬倍的引力差異

en: Your cells get torn apart, as your body stretches more and more, until you are a hot stream of plasma, one atom wide.
zh: 當你的身體不停被拉扯，你的細胞被撕開當你的身體不停被拉扯，你的細胞被撕開直到你變成高溫的流動電漿只有一個原子的大小

en: Two, you die a very quick death.
zh: 二：你會死得更快

en: Very soon after you cross the event horizon, you would hit a firewall and be terminated in an instant.
zh: 當你一跨過事界你會撞到一道火牆並馬上被毀滅

en: Neither of these options are particularly pleasant.
zh: 兩種情況都不特別令人舒服

en: How soon you would die depends on the mass of the black hole.
zh: 你的死亡速度取決於黑洞的質量

en: A smaller black hole would kill you before you even enter its event horizon,
zh: 一個細小的黑洞在你進入事界前已經將你殺死

en: while you probably could travel inside a super size massive black hole for quite a while.
zh: 而你可能可以在一個大質量的黑洞的事界內停留一會

en: As a rule of thumb, the further away from the singularity you are, the longer you live.
zh: 根據經驗，你離奇點愈遠，你能生存更久根據經驗，你離奇點愈遠，你能生存更久根據經驗，你離奇點愈遠，你能生存更久

en: Black holes come in different sizes.
zh: 黑洞有不同大小

notes.example: How come you didn't text me back?

en: There are stellar mass black holes, with a few times the mass of sun, and the diameter of an asteroid.
zh: 有的是星際黑洞只有太陽質量的幾倍而直徑與小行星相約

en: And then there are the super massive black holes, which are found at the heart of every galaxy,
zh: 有的是超大質量的黑洞它們位於每個星系的中心

en: and have been feeding for billions of years.
zh: 而已被持續「養活」了上十億年之久

en: Currently, the largest super massive black hole known, is S5 0014+81.
zh: 目前，已知的最大質量黑洞是 S5 0014+81 目前，已知的最大質量黑洞是 S5 0014+81

en: 40 billion times the mass of our sun.
zh: 是太陽質量的四百億倍 （40,000,000,000 倍）

en: It is 236.7 billion kilometers in diameter, which is 47 times the distance from the sun to Pluto.
zh: 直徑長 2,367 億公里 （236,700,000,000 公里） 是太陽與冥王星之間的距離的 47 倍

en: As powerful as black holes are, they will eventually evaporate through a process called Hawking radiation.
zh: 就算黑洞那麼強大它們終會透過叫「霍金輻射」的過程被蒸發掉

en: To understand how this works, we have to look at empty space.
zh: 要明白它的原理我們需要考慮真空

en: Empty space is not really empty, but filled with virtual particles popping into existence and annihilating each other again.
zh: 真空並不是完全「空無一物」的而是充斥著虛對粒子，它們成對出現，又互相煙滅對方而是充斥著虛對粒子，它們成對出現，又互相煙滅對方

en: When this happens right on the edge of a black hole, one of the virtual particles will be drawn into the black hole,
zh: 當這發生在黑洞的邊緣時其實一個虛對粒子會被拉入黑洞

en: and the other will escape and become a real particle.
zh: 而另一半則逃離黑洞，變成真實粒子

en: So the black hole is losing energy.
zh: 所以黑洞正在流失能量

en: This happens incredibly slowly at first, and gets faster as the black hole becomes smaller.
zh: 這個過程起初非常慢隨黑洞縮細，該過程（流失能量）慢慢加快

en: When it arrives at the mass of a large asteroid, its radiating at room temperature.
zh: 當它的質量相等於大型小行星的質量它以室溫流失能量

en: When it has the mass of a mountain, it radiates with about the heat of our sun.
zh: 當它的質量相等於一座山的質量它以太陽的溫度流失能量

en: and in the last second of its life, the black hole radiates away with the energy of billions of nuclear bombs in a huge explosion.
zh: 而在它被完全蒸發掉前一秒黑洞會爆炸並釋放出相等於十億個核彈的能量，然後被完全蒸發掉

notes.zh: just need a second：請稍等我們一下
notes.example: Sorry, we just need a second to check the menu.

en: But this process is incredibly slow, The biggest black holes we know, might take up a googol year to evaporate.
zh: 但這過程非常緩慢我們已知最大的黑洞要用上 10^100 年才會蒸發掉 （Googol = 10^100，即 1 之後有 100 個零）

en: This is so long that when the last black hole radiates away, nobody will be around to witness it.
zh: 這段時間長得很，沒有人可以見證到最後一個黑洞被蒸發掉這段時間長得很，沒有人可以見證到最後一個黑洞被蒸發掉

en: The universe will have become uninhabitable, long before then.
zh: 遠在這件事發生前，宇宙已變得不適合居住遠在這件事發生前，宇宙已變得不適合居住

en: This is not the end of our story, there are loads more interesting ideas about black holes, we'll explore them in part 2.
zh: 這個故事還未完關於黑洞，還有很多有趣的想法我們會在第二部分繼續探討
